title: ReasoningReceipt
description: Final receipt for a recursive reasoning run, including trace hash, replay class, and coordination posture summaries.

traceHashMethod.description: What traceHash actually commits to. 'event-content-chain' is a rolling hash over the emitted event bytes (h_0 = '', h_n = sha256(h_{n-1} + line_n)) and therefore covers content and order together. 'event-id-sequence' covers only the concatenated event identifiers and is invariant under any change to what the events said — it distinguishes a run from a different run, but does not detect a tampered or re-summarised trace. Absent means 'event-id-sequence' by construction: receipts written before this field existed carry the weaker guarantee, and a verifier must not read their traceHash as content integrity.

assay.description: Run-level epistemic posture: a render-time summary projected from the run's ReasoningAssay records. A cache, not the source of truth — re-derivable by re-projecting the referenced assays against the current AssayStandard, so it is optional and never authoritative over the assays themselves. The reserved receipt landing spot for binding + verifier calibration.

assayRefs.description: URNs of the ReasoningAssay records covering this run's claims. Referenced, not embedded, so each verdict stays independently re-projectable.

overallState.description: assay() projection for the run's overall answer AT projectedAt — the weakest-link readout across the referenced assays. A cache of the tuple, not a stored severity.

binding.description: Weakest evidence binding across the run's assays. A single post-hoc claim pulls the run's binding to post-hoc; recorded so a post-hoc 'verified' run is not mistaken for an inline one.

calibrationRef.description: The AssayStandard the overall verdict rests on. An absent or uncalibrated reference caps overallState at 'sad'.

counts.description: Tally of the referenced assays by projected state at projectedAt.

projectedAt.description: When this summary was projected. Re-projection against a newer AssayStandard yields a later summary rather than mutating this one.
